confirmed_host_defect: BindVertexBuffers recorded setVertexInputEXT before ObtainBuffer. Automatic image publication can scheduler.Finish during acquisition, leaving input state on a submitted command buffer. Later index/indirect/count acquisitions can likewise discard earlier vertex/index bindings. Vulkan state is not inherited by a new command buffer.
causal_limit: Latest native run has no draw-preparation tick instrumentation and no validation VUID; this host defect is not established as the cause of GoT GPU loss.

Sample draw-preparation-flush events when resource preparation advances the submission tick.
